items.exampleEn: The statistics show that online sales are growing.
items.exampleZh: 統計數據顯示網路銷售正在成長。

items.exampleEn: The waiter carried a tall stack of plates to the kitchen.
items.exampleZh: 服務生端著一大疊盤子走向廚房。

items.exampleEn: The hotel charged an excessive fee for parking.
items.exampleZh: 這家飯店收取過高的停車費。

items.exampleEn: The new route is considerably shorter than the old one.
Dust accumulates quickly in this room.
items.exampleZh: 這個房間灰塵很快就積起來。

items.exampleEn: The lengthy instructions made the game hard to learn.
items.exampleZh: 冗長的說明讓這個遊戲很難學。

items.exampleEn: The kitchen gets ample sunlight in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 廚房早上有充足的陽光。

items.exampleEn: The company wants to broaden its range of products.
items.exampleZh: 公司想擴大產品的種類。

items.sentenceEn: Over the years, she has accumulated a large collection of books.
items.sentenceZh: 這些年來，她累積了大量藏書。

items.audioEn: Don't worry. We have ample time before the train leaves.
items.audioZh: 別擔心，火車開之前我們還有充足的時間。
options: They should run to the train

items.sentenceEn: Rents in the city center are considerably higher than in the suburbs.
items.sentenceZh: 市中心的房租比郊區高得多。

items.sentenceEn: Learning a second language can broaden your job choices.
items.sentenceZh: 學第二外語可以擴大你的工作選擇。

items.stemEn: The meeting was so ____ that some people fell asleep.
items.stemZh: 會議冗長到有些人都睡著了。

items.stemEn: Please put the plates in a neat ____ on the table.
items.stemZh: 請把盤子整齊地疊成一疊放在桌上。

items.passageEn: Our office used to print everything. Paper accumulated on every desk, and some people kept stacks of old reports that nobody read. Last year, the manager looked at the statistics: we were using an excessive amount of paper, about ten boxes a week. After a lengthy meeting, we decided to stop printing most documents. Now we save our files online, and there is ample space on our desks. Our costs have dropped considerably, and the change has broadened our thinking about other ways to save.
items.passageZh: 我們辦公室以前什麼都印出來。每張桌上都堆滿紙，有些人還留著一疊疊沒人看的舊報告。去年，經理看了統計數據：我們用紙量過多，一週大約十箱。經過一場冗長的會議，我們決定大部分文件都不再列印。現在我們把檔案存在網路上，桌上有充足的空間。我們的成本大幅降低，這個改變也拓寬了我們對其他節省方法的思考。

items.promptZh: 我們有充足的時間準備這場會議。
referenceEn: We have ample time to prepare for this meeting.
There is ample time for us to get ready for the meeting.
rubricZh: ample 放在名詞前，表示「充足的」（例如 ample time、ample space）
「準備」可寫 prepare for、get ready for 等

items.promptZh: 很多家長認為作業量過多。
referenceEn: Many parents think that the amount of homework is excessive.
Many parents feel the homework load is excessive.
rubricZh: excessive 表示「過度的、過多的」（例如 is excessive、an excessive amount of 等）
「作業量」可寫，例如 the amount of homework、the homework load 等
